name: plugin.context_type_system
description: Context provenance, type channel separation, origin ledger verification, token budgeting, and prompt assembly engine

entrypoints.name: context_add
entrypoints.description: Register a typed context item into a session, checking origin ledger against protected channels

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: Unique context session identifier

parameters.name: context_type
parameters.description: Context channel type: 'instruction', 'memory', 'evidence', or 'tool_output'

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Text content of the context item

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Origin source identifier (e.g. 'system', 'tool:database', 'docs_retriever')

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: Priority ranking for ordering within prompt section (higher priority renders first)

entrypoints.name: context_transform
entrypoints.description: Explicitly transition a context item across permitted policy boundaries, recording derivation lineage

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: Unique context session identifier

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: Request ID of the item to transform

parameters.name: to_type
parameters.description: Target context type (e.g. 'evidence', 'memory')

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Optional override source label for the transformed item

entrypoints.name: context_validate_tool_output
entrypoints.description: Validate raw tool execution output and elevate it to evidence if passing validation criteria

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: Unique context session identifier

parameters.name: tool_request_id
parameters.description: Request ID of the tool_output context item to validate and promote

parameters.name: strict_mode
parameters.description: Enforce strict error keyword checking during validation

entrypoints.name: context_assemble_prompt
entrypoints.description: Render typed context items into ordered prompt sections with optional token budgeting and channel quotas

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: Unique context session identifier

parameters.name: section_order
parameters.description: Custom sequence of ContextTypes to render (default: ['instruction', 'memory', 'evidence', 'tool_output'])

parameters.name: custom_labels
parameters.description: Optional dictionary mapping context types to custom section headers

parameters.name: max_tokens
parameters.description: Optional token ceiling for total prompt assembly with priority knapsack pruning

parameters.name: channel_quotas
parameters.description: Optional dictionary mapping context types to budget quota fractions (e.g. {'evidence': 0.4, 'instruction': 0.3})

entrypoints.name: context_inspect_ledger
entrypoints.description: Audit provenance records, origin types, transition history, and ledger keys for a context session

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: Unique context session identifier

parameters.name: filter_type
parameters.description: Optional ContextType string to filter returned items by

entrypoints.name: context_get_lineage
entrypoints.description: Trace the full multi-hop derivation chain back to the root observation (Isnad lineage audit)

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: Unique context session identifier

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: Target context item request ID to trace lineage for

entrypoints.name: context_export_session
entrypoints.description: Export session state as a portable snapshot dictionary

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: Unique context session identifier

entrypoints.name: context_import_session
entrypoints.description: Restore a session from a snapshot dictionary

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: Unique context session identifier

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Serialized session snapshot dictionary
